contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ PAX AVG

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Postumus (260-269), Reece period 13, Cunetio 2450:1. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left with right arm outstretched and transverse sceptre. Reverse inscription: PAX AVG. Diameter: 22.5mm, Weight: 2.98gms, die axis: 6
